profile.headline: Do the right thing. Do whatever it takes. And have fun.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Participate in the technical design and implementation of new products or enhancements. Participates in all phases of the development cycle: concept, technical design, prototype, code development, testing, release to QA and implementation.

positions.title: Lead/Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Develops, enhances, debugs, supports, maintains and tests software applications that support business units or supporting functions. These application program solutions may involve diverse development platforms, software, technologies, and tools. Participates in the design, development and implementation of complex applications, often using new technologies. May provide technical direction and system architecture for individual initiatives. Serves as a fully seasoned/proficient technical resource. Will not have direct reports but may lead projects and direct activities of a team related to special initiatives or operations. May have responsibility for a project. May collaborate with external programmers to coordinate delivery of software application. Routine accountability is for technical knowledge and capabilities. Works under minimal supervision, with general guidance from more seasoned consultants. Typically requires 5-7 years of experience. 

Skills / Qualifications: (REQUIRED)
-.Net C# - 5 years
-JavaScript
-some exposure to web services / XML
-Visual Studio
-HTML
-ability to exhibit Time Management
-ability to Communicate Clearly to Developers or Non-Technical partners
-ability to work with minimal supervision

 The following are a plus, but not required:
-jquery
-SSRS
-IIS

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Contribute to the architecture and design of software applications and systems perform analysis, diagnostics, development, testing and documentation of software applications, systems, and sub-systems isolate and correct application errors in a timely manner ensure the integrity of the database structure periodically manage or lead various phases of the development and maintenance of approved projects mentor and support junior developers.

Job Requirements
Web technologies (Web services, HTTP, SSL, ASP . Net) eXtensible Markup Language (XML) Microsoft .Net Development tools & technologies (Visual Basic, C#, etc.) Object-Oriented Programming Database Modeling & Normalization (SQL Server) Scripting technologies (JavaScript) Use-Cases & Unified Modeling Language (UML)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
-	Developed and maintained software to export data from SAP to E-Commerce databases and to push web transactional data back into SAP using Visual Basic, BAPI, EDI, and iDOC. 
-	Developed web sites and web pages for consumer, customer, intranet, and corporate sites using ASP.NET, ASP, & Javascript.
-	Developed Sales & Finance reports for Sales Reps and Executives using ASP, ASP.NET, and MS Reporting Service.
-	Imported/exported data with MS SQL Server, MS Access databases, and MS Excel spreadsheets.
-	Developed automated processes for transfering data files to/from customers and Wachovia bank using FTP, PGP, and email.
-	Administrated MS SQL Server 2000 database warehouses: managed users, developed databases, tables, queries, stored procedures, DTS packages, Email notifications, etc. 
-	Administrated Web servers: MS Window Server 2003, IIS 5 & 6. 
-	Developed kios machines for display in stores
-	Generated usage statistic reports for web sites using WebTrend Reporting Server.
-	Provided Visual Basic and database training.
